notes.title: The Descent of King Hesper
notes.notes:
[i]The Descent of King Hesper[/i] is a newly-released quality hold (expansion) for DROD that you can play now [i]for free[/i]. It is the culmination of ten years of work by 45 architects, testers, writers, spriters, and programmers from the Caravel community who wanted to share their creation with the world.

It is similar in style to the official holds, starting at beginner-level difficulty, exploring game elements one at a time, and ramping up to expert-level puzzles. There are lots of bonus puzzles and secret areas to find along the way.

This hold is absolutely massive -- nearly 2,500 rooms and 150 levels! Best of all, you can download it [url=https://forum.caravelgames.com/viewtopic.php?TopicID=46328]from the Caravel Forum[/url] for free.

Anyone looking for more high quality DROD content before the next official Caravel release should do themselves a favor and check out [i]The Descent of King Hesper[/i].

Happy DRODing!

notes.title: Smitemaster's Selection CaravelNet DLC fixes
notes.notes:
Smitemaster's Selection DLC updates have been deployed to address CaravelNet functionality issues.

The holds [i]Beethro's Teacher[/i] and [i]Complex Complex[/i] have been updated to the latest version available on CaravelNet.

[i]The Choice[/i] has also been synced to the current version on CaravelNet.

CaravelNet functionality should now be active and working properly for these three DLC holds.

notes.title: Have You Played DROD: Gunthro and the Epic Blunder?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day of the year, perhaps for all time.

If you’ve paid any attention to my scribblings over the last few years, one of the recurrent themes you may have noticed is my hatred of puzzles games. Or rather, as I like to say, their hatred of me. But, as I’ve acknowledged in the past, wrap a strong theme or story around the puzzles and I might be fooled into paying attention, and from there I can be won over completely. The Deadly Rooms of Death [official site] series, a fantasy RPG that is actually a puzzle game, almost got me.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Critical DROD level editor fix
notes.notes:
A [url=http://forum.caravelgames.com/viewtopic.php?TopicID=41502]critical level editor bug[/url] was observed in DROD:GatEB on Steam.

This issue causes odd room placement errors in the game's level editor.  It exists for anyone playing the game before this announcement went up on 9/25.

We patched this issue in the game engine as soon as we learned of it.  However, in order to fix the issue on your end, you will need to reset your local player data files once by doing the following:

[olist]
[*] Export your player progress (optional):
Go to the Main Menu, click "Change Player", then click "Export" to save your player game progress to a file on disk.
[*] Delete the game's local data files:
Exit the game.
Go to "C:\Users\<your username>\Documents\Caravel\drod-5_0\" (on Windows) and delete the five "*.dat" files in this folder.
[*] Start the game.  If using Steam auto-cloud sync, select to use local (not remote) files.
[*] Re-import your player progress (optional):
Re-import any custom holds you had installed, then click "Import" on the player creation screen and select your exported .player file to import your progress back into the game.
[/olist]

Linux and OS X patches uploading soon.

Our sincere apologies for the inconvenience.
